name: Appartment Oberberg
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Appartment Oberberg is a holiday apartment located in the Austrian state of Tyrol. The accommodation features a self-contained apartment with a kitchenette and private bathroom. Designed for self-caterers, the apartment is equipped with all necessary household appliances. It is situated in a peaceful setting, ideal for a relaxing holiday. From the holiday apartment, you can easily explore hiking trails and ski outings in the stunning Tyrolean mountain landscape. The accommodation typically includes a balcony or terrace.
